name: Presentr Practice
tagline: Prepare a spoken mock interview for a specific job
description: Tell Cline the job you're interviewing for (and the company or job posting, if you have them) and Presentr Practice prepares a spoken mock interview for that role, returning a link to start it in your browser. The interview runs by voice or text, in English or Spanish, and ends with a scored review: an overall score, a score per skill and coaching notes. No sign-in needed to connect.
